verdicts.reason: Both break the original idea. The quote no longer sits inside the illustrated frame; the frame has been shrunk to a small thumbnail that shows stray 'BEAUTY ILLUSTRATION' placeholder text, and the quote is broken into short one- or two-word lines. A keeps 'CAROLYN MURPHY' directly under the quote in reading order, but the text block is jammed against the top, right and bottom edges. B is worse because the attribution is cut off from the quote and placed under the illustration on the other side, so it reads as a caption for the artwork.
